name: LT - Report Daily Rollups
description: Aggregates daily KPI tables for the embedded report. The workflow now preserves GA-backed daily summary, channel, UTM, and landing-page rows while writing CRM rollups.

parameters.jsCode:
const daysBack = 90;
const windowStart = "CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '89 days'";
const windowEnd = "CURRENT_DATE";
const workflowName = 'LT - Report Daily Rollups';
const sourceSystem = 'rollups';

const sql = `
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_contacts;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_opps;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_forms;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_dates;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_daily_opps_fixed;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_existing_daily;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_contacts AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source Last', ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium Last', ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign Last', ''), 'unknown') AS campaign,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content Last', ''), 'unknown') AS content,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_term_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_term_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Term First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Term Last', ''), 'unknown') AS term,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page Last', ''), 'unknown') AS landing_page,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_channel', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_source', ''))) IN ('email', 'organic social', 'organic search', 'direct', 'referral', 'unassigned') THEN INITCAP(LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_channel', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_source', ''))))
    WHEN COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%email%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%newsletter%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%mailchimp%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%sendgrid%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%klaviyo%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%mailer%' THEN 'Email'
    WHEN COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%facebook%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%instagram%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%linkedin%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%twitter%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%x.com%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%xcom%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%tiktok%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%youtube%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%pinterest%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%reddit%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%social%' THEN 'Organic Social'
    WHEN COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%google%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%bing%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%yahoo%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%duckduckgo%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%search%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%seo%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%organic%' THEN 'Organic Search'
    WHEN COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%referral%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%affiliate%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%partner%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%referr%' THEN 'Referral'
    WHEN COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') = '' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%direct%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%none%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%(none)%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%not set%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%unknown%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%manual%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%offline%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%sms%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%call%' OR COALESCE(ch.channel_text, '') LIKE '%phone%' THEN 'Direct'
    ELSE 'Unassigned'
  END AS channel,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_reason', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_trigger_type', ''), 'ghl_source') AS routing_reason,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(payload_json->>'email', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'Email', '')) AS email,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_channel', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_source', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source Last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium First', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium Last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign First', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign Last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_first', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_last', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content First', ''),
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content Last', '')
  )) AS channel_text
) ch
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'status', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'status', ''), 'open') AS status,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(metrics_json->>'monetary_value', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'monetaryValue', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'amount', ''), '0')::numeric AS monetary_value,

FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

  NOW()

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_bridge_traffic AS
SELECT DISTINCT ON (report_date, ghl_contact_id)
  report_date,
  ghl_contact_id,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) IN ('email', 'organic social', 'organic search', 'direct', 'referral', 'unassigned') THEN INITCAP(LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')))
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%newsletter%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%mailchimp%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%sendgrid%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%klaviyo%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%mailer%' THEN 'Email'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%instagram%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%linkedin%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%twitter%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%x.com%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%xcom%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%tiktok%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%youtube%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%pinterest%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%reddit%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%social%' THEN 'Organic Social'

    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%direct%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%none%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%(none)%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%not set%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%unknown%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%manual%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%offline%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%sms%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%call%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''), '')) LIKE '%phone%' THEN 'Direct'
    ELSE 'Unassigned'
  END AS channel,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(medium, ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
  updated_at
FROM report_bridge_traffic_to_lead
WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd}
  AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
ORDER BY report_date, ghl_contact_id, updated_at DESC;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_dates AS
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_contacts
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_opps
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_forms
UNION
SELECT report_date FROM report_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_existing_daily AS
SELECT
  report_date,
  COALESCE(sessions, 0) AS sessions,
  COALESCE(users, 0) AS users,
  COALESCE(new_users, 0) AS new_users,
  COALESCE(engaged_sessions, 0) AS engaged_sessions,
  COALESCE(engagement_rate, 0) AS engagement_rate,
  COALESCE(gsc_clicks, 0) AS gsc_clicks,
  COALESCE(gsc_impressions, 0) AS gsc_impressions,
  COALESCE(gsc_ctr, 0) AS gsc_ctr,
  COALESCE(gsc_position, 0) AS gsc_position
FROM report_daily_summary
WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_daily_opps_fixed AS
SELECT
  report_date,
  ghl_opportunity_id,
  MAX(ghl_contact_id) AS ghl_contact_id,
  MAX(stage) AS stage,
  MAX(status) AS status,
  MAX(monetary_value) AS monetary_value,
  MAX(CASE
    WHEN LOWER(stage) = 'closed won' OR LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END) AS is_won,
  MAX(CASE
    WHEN LOWER(stage) = 'closed lost' OR LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END) AS is_lost,
  MAX(CASE
    WHEN LOWER(stage) IN ('booked', 'discovery scheduled', 'meeting scheduled', 'meeting requested') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END) AS is_meeting
FROM tmp_report_opps
GROUP BY report_date, ghl_opportunity_id;

DELETE FROM report_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_daily_summary (
  report_date, sessions, users, new_users, engaged_sessions, engagement_rate, gsc_clicks, gsc_impressions, gsc_ctr, gsc_position, contacts_created, form_submissions, opportunities_created, meetings_booked, closed_won_count, closed_won_revenue, closed_lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  COALESCE(ed.sessions, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.users, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.new_users, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.engaged_sessions, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.engagement_rate, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.gsc_clicks, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.gsc_impressions, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.gsc_ctr, 0),
  COALESCE(ed.gsc_position, 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_forms f WHERE f.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.is_meeting = 1), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.is_won = 1), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.monetary_value) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.is_won = 1), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.is_lost = 1), 0),
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d', 'daily_summary_fix', 'integrated')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
LEFT JOIN tmp_existing_daily ed ON ed.report_date = d.report_date;

DELETE FROM report_channel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd} AND metadata->>'source_system' = 'rollups';
INSERT INTO report_channel_daily_summary (
  report_date, channel, traffic_source, source, medium, sessions, users, new_users, leads, opportunities, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
WITH lead_facts AS (
  SELECT
    c.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    c.ghl_contact_id
  FROM tmp_report_contacts c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= c.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
opp_facts AS (
  SELECT
    o.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    o.ghl_opportunity_id,
    o.status,
    o.monetary_value
  FROM tmp_report_opps o
  LEFT JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= o.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
combined AS (
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id) AS leads, 0::bigint AS opportunities, 0::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM lead_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, 0::bigint AS leads, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM opp_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.channel,
  c.source,
  c.source,
  c.medium,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  SUM(c.leads)::bigint AS leads,
  SUM(c.opportunities)::bigint AS opportunities,
  SUM(c.closed_won_revenue)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN combined c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5;

DELETE FROM report_funnel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_funnel_daily_summary (
  report_date, traffic, leads, sales, contact_to_opportunity_rate, opportunity_to_win_rate, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  COALESCE(ed.sessions, 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.is_won = 1), 0),
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0), 4)
    ELSE 0
  END,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0) > 0

INSERT INTO report_channel_daily_summary (
  report_date, channel, traffic_source, source, medium, sessions, users, new_users, leads, opportunities, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
WITH lead_facts AS (
  SELECT
    c.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    c.ghl_contact_id
  FROM tmp_report_contacts c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= c.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
opp_facts AS (
  SELECT
    o.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    o.ghl_opportunity_id,
    o.status,
    o.monetary_value
  FROM tmp_report_opps o
  LEFT JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= o.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
combined AS (
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id) AS leads, 0::bigint AS opportunities, 0::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM lead_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, 0::bigint AS leads, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM opp_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.channel,
  c.source,
  c.source,
  c.medium,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  SUM(c.leads)::bigint AS leads,
  SUM(c.opportunities)::bigint AS opportunities,
  SUM(c.closed_won_revenue)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN combined c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5;

    THEN ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.is_won = 1), 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_daily_opps_fixed o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0), 4)
    ELSE 0

  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,

)
WITH opp_daily AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (report_date, ghl_opp_id)
    ph.report_date,
    ph.source_key AS ghl_opp_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ph.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_id', ''), NULLIF(ph.payload_json->>'pipelineId', '')) AS pipeline_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ph.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_id', ''), NULLIF(ph.payload_json->>'pipelineStageId', '')) AS stage_id,

  FROM report_raw_ghl_pipeline_history ph
  WHERE ph.source_system = 'ghl'
    AND ph.report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd}
  ORDER BY report_date, ghl_opp_id, ph.loaded_at DESC
),
opp_transitions AS (
  SELECT
    o.report_date,
    o.ghl_opp_id,
    CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.pipeline_id, ''), 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'FRjpDZ1HWj3UPgczsu3t' THEN 'Warm'
      WHEN 'dhdlf3O4tymxFtHk4aqq' THEN 'Sales Outreach'
      WHEN 'MThKauqlvnEFuFmAkyWX' THEN 'Sales'
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.pipeline_id, ''), 'Unknown')
    END AS pipeline,
    CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.stage_id, ''), 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'b961de1f-34fd-4b66-b032-f21225654868' THEN 'New'
      WHEN '3b3bd98d-cbb9-4c50-8cf3-b4eba29061c2' THEN 'Qualified (MQL)'
      WHEN '477c0b59-4a64-4566-81d6-63e233362520' THEN 'Routed to Outreach'
      WHEN '98775f02-0018-4629-9e69-0b1fcab293eb' THEN 'Nurture Active'
      WHEN 'dae2ddc5-a031-4ffa-bcdb-79d5c9afe91b' THEN 'Disqualified'
      WHEN '3529dd3d-cab0-4279-967c-1aea203de4fb' THEN 'New'
      WHEN 'b97e42b1-b4c2-4759-8212-33596a085cf2' THEN 'Attempting Contact 1st Attempt'
      WHEN 'c46c3be3-a216-4489-8ae3-c4284cfc747f' THEN '2nd attempt'
      WHEN 'c8b7a450-462a-497d-ab86-65f9a8e9b082' THEN '3rd attempt'
      WHEN '9ced8010-dfd7-4d5b-aa9c-c2eb58fca94d' THEN 'Engaged'
      WHEN '1ab47457-c945-4d16-9dd7-305583823114' THEN 'Meeting Requested'
      WHEN '1f95dd0a-1cf2-4d31-abad-825d97d3ef69' THEN 'Booked'
      WHEN '23276991-fbb3-4b0f-8d65-35c737b62bdd' THEN 'Unresponsive'
      WHEN '6f5aa304-a190-40da-8556-7c65bbc52733' THEN 'Discovery Scheduled'
      WHEN 'facd3d31-c634-40c5-9271-17d608b4379c' THEN 'Discovery Completed'
      WHEN '42b12e59-9b51-4c82-b597-4a9c972322c9' THEN 'Proposal Sent'
      WHEN 'f9022c83-7791-45c9-903d-381668454b2f' THEN 'Negotiation'
      WHEN 'f6b65baa-eac8-4f02-b91e-2ab0c8841b2d' THEN 'Closed Won'
      WHEN 'd7784617-96f4-4ae4-8b3e-e2088b62627d' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.stage_id, ''), 'Unknown')
    END AS stage,
    o.stage_id,
    o.status,
    LEAD(o.stage_id) OVER (PARTITION BY o.ghl_opp_id ORDER BY o.report_date) AS next_stage_id,

  pipeline,
  stage,

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage_id IS DISTINCT FROM prev_stage_id OR prev_stage_id IS NULL)::int AS moved_in_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage_id IS DISTINCT FROM next_stage_id OR next_stage_id IS NULL)::int AS moved_out_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(stage) = 'closed won' OR LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won'))::int AS won_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(stage) = 'closed lost' OR LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost'))::int AS lost_count,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,

FROM opp_transitions
